newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end firm, Flughafen under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firm, Flughafen under pressure.

text.p: 1320 GMT - Austrian shares end marginally firm after aimless trade.
Traders say see little money from investors with market at current levels and are cautiously optimistic for next week.
* February ATX future down 0.2 points at 1,175.8.
* 12 ATX shares up, seven down, two unchanged.
* Leading gainer AMS, up 4.52 percent at 995.
* Top loser Vienna airport operator Flughafen, down 3.84 percent at 551.
